source.title: Fixture — one instance of every verdict

notes: A CI fixture, not a case anyone scores: it exists so the schema is exercised by pnpm run validate:schemas on every commit. The runnable case with a script beside it is evals/overlays/_synthetic/.

marks.why: the figure is the sentence; the reference holds it on screen while the narration lands it
pure text lifting the turn of the argument — no fact to carry, so it is the emphasis class and its own budget
a real date anchor, so the gate would allow a DateStamp — and the reference puts nothing there, because the year is scene-setting the viewer will not be asked to remember

marks.source_words: nobody wrote any of it down
marks.why: nothing in the span is an anchor at all; a trivial negative, kept so the file shows both kinds

the reference animates borders moving over a held map. RouteMap draws a route and RegionHighlight highlights a fixed region; neither animates a change, and no field carries one. Excluded rather than scored as a miss — this pipeline never claimed the capability.
